# Bitview

> Bitview is a free, open-source Bitcoin data server: on-chain metrics, blocks, mempool and mining data, with charts and an API, at bitview.space or beside your own Bitcoin Core node. 22904 on-chain time-series and 107 API operations.

## API

- Version: `v0.13.0`
- Base URL: https://bitview.space
- Authentication: None
- Browser access: Permissive CORS
- [Terms of use](https://bitview.space/terms/)
- [Privacy policy](https://bitview.space/privacy/)
- [Support](https://bitview.space/support/)
- [Full plain-text reference](https://bitview.space/llms-full.txt)
- [Compact API summary](https://bitview.space/api.json)
- [Full OpenAPI](https://bitview.space/openapi.json)
- [Series catalog](https://bitview.space/api/series)
- [Interactive documentation](https://bitview.space/api)

Build tools from the full OpenAPI document; the compact summary is a smaller custom (non-OpenAPI) overview. Use `llms-full.txt` only when a complete readable reference is needed.

## Series workflow

1. `GET /api/series/search?q=<q>`: search by meaning with plain words; it returns series ids.
2. `GET /api/series/{series}`: read a returned id's description, supported indexes, value type, unit (what the value type measures), accumulation (how its values combine over time), and the indexes whose values can be null (missing or undefined).
3. `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}`, `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/latest`, `GET /api/series/bulk?series=<series>&index=<index>`: pick one of those indexes and fetch its values (`start` inclusive, `end` exclusive), the latest value alone, or several comma-separated series at once.

Never invent a series id: only ids the API returned exist.

## MCP

- Endpoint: https://mcp.bitview.space/
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: None
- [Setup for each assistant](https://mcp.bitview.space/)

The MCP server is stateless and read-only, with a tool for most of these operations.

## Clients

- [JavaScript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bitview-client)
- [Python](https://pypi.org/project/bitview-client/)
- [Rust](https://crates.io/crates/bitview_client)

## Agent Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://bitview.space/.well-known/agent-skills/bitview/SKILL.md), listed in the [skill index](https://bitview.space/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [Claude Code plugin](https://mcp.bitview.space/#connect) with the skill and the MCP server
